title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
quote: It is very, very early and very limited traction that we are seeing so far

title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents
quote: In Security Settings, you can set an overall Agents policy, then choose a different policy for each supported personal agent: Allow (do not block), Block on pages with ads, or Block.

title: fix(core): fail closed when a gate hook throws
quote: A throw in those two phases now stops the payment with reason extension_hook_error and the thrown message.

title: [Bug]: a throwing beforeVerify/beforeSettle hook is ignored, so extension gates fail open
quote: When a resource-server hook throws in beforeVerify or beforeSettle, the exception is logged and the loop continues as if the hook had passed.

title: fix(core): use phase-specific error codes for throwing gate hooks
quote: Those hooks also run manual and scheme hooks, not only extensions, so the naming was misleading.

title: Document fail-closed behavior for resource server gate hooks
quote: Updated the lifecycle hooks documentation to accurately reflect that onBeforeVerify and onBeforeSettle hooks on x402ResourceServer fail closed when they throw.

title: fix(xrpl): enforce spend caps in issued-currency units
quote: A normal RLUSD price such as $100 passed the client's default $1 cap because XRPL's default asset scale treated ledger values as atomic units.

title: fix: access key close authorization signing for Tempo sessions
quote: signCloseAuthorization was wrapping access key signatures in a keychain envelope, which TIP-1034 rejects.

title: fix: enforce session origin and payment policy boundaries
quote: Automatic payment paths could sign relayed session challenges, reuse channels without origin ownership, or lose approval and swap policies through nested adapters.

title: fix: credit failed prepaid streams and expose refund reconciliation
quote: A prepaid SSE item can fail before delivery after its charge has already settled. Credit unsettled failures and expose merchant reconciliation when a local credit cannot safely reverse the charge.

title: fix: bind session manager payments to request origin
quote: a session manager reused against a second origin could disclose its existing payment channel and authorize vouchers for an endpoint it was never meant to pay

title: fix: charge request-priced session content before handlers
quote: a request-priced SSE route could run the application handler before confirming the channel had funds, so repeatedly rejected requests could still perform unpaid work

title: feat(ts): facilitator-managed voucher custody for EVM batch settlement
quote: Ports facilitator-managed voucher custody for EVM batch settlement from the Go SDK to TypeScript, with follow-up lifecycle and state-integrity hardening in both SDKs.
